ai.title: context-pruner adds cacheExpiryMs param
ai.summary: context-pruner now accepts cacheExpiryMs to override default 5-minute Anthropic cache expiry. base2.ts injects 10-minute expiry for free-mode agents via serialized handleSteps. Scope limited to agents/base2/base2.ts and agents/context-pruner.ts. Free-mode pruner also strips USER_PROMPT tags when params present.

eli5.text: When you use a free agent, it now keeps its conversation notes cached for twice as long (10 minutes instead of 5), so you don't lose context as quickly between steps if you pause. Free users will also notice less leftover clutter, since the system quietly removes extra prompt tags that used to stick around during pruning. If you're on a paid plan, your agent still uses the default 5-minute cleanup window, so nothing changes for you today.

ai.title: Remove thinker-with-files-gemini from free agents
ai.summary: Removed thinker-with-files-gemini agent from free mode. Deleted agent definition from FREE_MODE_AGENT_MODELS and stripped spawn instructions from base2 prompt. Updated spawn-agents tool schema to remove agent from filePaths description.

eli5.text: If you're using Codebuff for free, the assistant will no longer automatically bring in a separate AI helper that uses Google's Gemini model to tackle tricky coding problems with files. Instead, free users will rely on the other built-in assistants already available to them. This change simply turns off that one optional helper for the free plan, while paid users and the rest of the system continue to work as before.

ai.title: Codebuff CLI version bump to 1.0.642
ai.summary: The codebuff package version in cli/release/package.json was incremented from 1.0.641 to 1.0.642 as a release-bump commit. This release encapsulates the same-day changes since 1.0.641, including Minimax M2.7 model support and MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5 routing in the web Fireworks layer, GPT-5.4 and Sonnet-4.6 eval judge models, Opus 4.7 agent defaults, and billing changes such as removing the initial free credit grant on signup and disabling referral credits via a zero bonus constant. The version bump itself is a metadata-only change with +1/-1 lines.
ai.evidence: Commit 1c689273 modifies cli/release/package.json, bumping the codebuff package version field from 1.0.641 to 1.0.642 in the single diff hunk.

eli5.text: This release upgrades your default AI assistant to Anthropic's latest Opus 4.7 model while also adding support for Minimax M2.7 and MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5 through the Fireworks provider. Your free-tier accounts now get stronger protections against credit overdraft, the new free-agent model set has been refreshed to swap in GLM 5.1, and long-standing bugs like double-billing on Anthropic routes and incorrect context-window pruning have been fixed. On top of that, the built-in agent evaluation scores now run on GPT-5.4 and Sonnet 4.6 with higher concurrency, so nightly accuracy checks finish faster. Upgrading means you get the newest flagship model by default, fewer surprise errors when your conversation gets trimmed, safer free-credit accounting, and access to the latest mid-tier language models when you bring your own Fireworks API key.

ai.title: Freebuff 0.0.34 release bundles model and billing updates
ai.summary: Freebuff version bumped to 0.0.33 -> 0.0.34 in cli/release/package.json, packaging the cumulative work since the prior release. This release aggregates model additions (Minimax M2.7, MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5, Opus 4.7 defaults), billing gate fixes (overdraw protection, referral credit disablement, removal of initial free credit grant), and cost-extraction bug fixes (Anthropic double-charge, OpenRouter streaming fallback billing) documented in the release notes. The version field in freebuff/cli/release/package.json is the sole modified file, with all other changes delivered via earlier commits in the same release window.
ai.evidence: Diff modifies freebuff/cli/release/package.json: version field changed from "0.0.33" to "0.0.34". Analysis notes confirm this commit is a release-bump to version 0.0.34, aggregating user-visible changes from prior commits.

eli5.text: This release upgrades your AI assistants to newer, more capable models and tightens up billing so you don't get charged twice for the same request. You get access to Minitab M2.7 and MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5, plus your coding agents now default to Opus 4.7, the latest and most capable version available. The context-pruning system that keeps long conversations from getting too big is now tested and reliable, so it trims your chat history accurately instead of cutting it short by mistake. Free-tier users can no longer overdraw their credit balance, and the system now blocks unpaid accounts from requesting expensive models through the free-chat endpoint. A new server-side monitor keeps tabs on Fireworks API performance round the clock, and the SDK now correctly filters which tools your custom extensions are allowed to use. Upgrading means you get the latest model performance out of the box, fairer billing that prevents double charges, and more dependable behavior for free users and long-running conversations.

ai.title: Increase test timeout for subscription limit enforcement
ai.summary: Bump test timeout to 15000ms in completions.test.ts. Fixes flaky non-streaming fetch-path tests hitting Bun's 5s default on loaded machines. Affects web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/__tests__/completions.test.ts.

eli5.text: Behind the scenes, the team gave the subscription-limit tests extra time to finish on busy machines. Tests that verify subscriber access checks were failing just past the five-second mark, so the allowed window was doubled to fifteen seconds. This is internal test maintenance only; if you looked, you would see longer timeouts on the subscription enforcement checks, and you would not notice anything different in the product today.

ai.title: CLI release HTTP client avoids DNS lookup after proxied CONNECT
ai.summary: Refactored CLI release installer HTTP logic into shared `http.js` module (`createReleaseHttpClient`) used by `cli/release` and `cli/release-staging`. Fixes post-CONNECT DNS lookups by passing pre-established proxy sockets directly to `https.request`. Updates `package.json` files to include `http.js` in published artifacts. Mechanism: `connectThroughProxy` returns a socket; `httpGet` uses this socket for the target request, bypassing local DNS resolution for the target hostname when a proxy is configured.

eli5.text: When the CLI tool downloads a new release version and you're connected through a corporate or network proxy server, the download process no longer makes an extra DNS lookup that could fail or leak the internal target hostname. Instead of resolving the download server's address locally after connecting through the proxy, the tool now reuses the already-established secure connection to the proxy directly for fetching the release package. This change affects anyone whose environment sets HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, or NO_PROXY variables, and if you looked at network traffic during an update you'd see one fewer DNS query hitting your local resolver after the proxy handshake. It's live today in the release tooling used by both the stable and staging update channels.

ai.title: fix code-map line count off-by-one
ai.summary: Fixed operator precedence bug in `packages/code-map/src/parse.ts`. `numLines` now correctly adds 1 to the newline count instead of evaluating `?? 0 + 1`. Scope limited to `code-map` package internals.

eli5.text: The internal assistant that counts how many lines are in a file was slightly wrong. For most files the count was fine, but for empty files it showed zero lines instead of one, so anything relying on that count for empty files got the wrong number. The fix makes the empty-file case report one line, matching the rest of the software. It is live today in the internal version of the assistant.

ai.title: Remove paid account gate from completions
ai.summary: Removed account age and paid relationship checks from `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`. Eliminates `MIN_ACCOUNT_AGE_DAYS` and `PAID_GATE_BYPASS_EMAILS` constants along with their associated 403 blocking logic for non-free mode requests. `created_at` field fetching and `principals` balance destructuring removed. Analytics tracking for `blocked_for_free_tier` deleted. BYOK header retrieval moved inline.

eli5.text: The assistant no longer checks whether you have a paid account or have been signed up for at least three days before handling a chat request that uses the non-free mode. Paid subscribers and bring-your-own-key users can now run those requests right away, even on a brand-new account, whereas previously a new or unpaid account would get a 403 error asking you to wait or upgrade. This is in effect today across the completions endpoint.
